purpose: Known-truth illustration of the same compensated objective's vanishing-power risk consequence; not a new phase-boundary accuracy study.
prediction: Frozen correctly calibrated posterior given independent binary response proxy: epsilon+(1-2*epsilon)*Z
estimated_parameters: Intercept, one Gaussian signal-coordinate slope and floor(0.6*m) independent Gaussian noise slopes; all true parameters zero
reference: Human ridge using the same m labels with penalty ||beta||^2/(2*m)
evaluation: Conditional expected test log loss and Brier loss from independent standard-normal one-dimensional integration at true outcome probability 1/2; no test labels are generated. Classification error equals 1/2 analytically.
separation: Minimum-norm feasible strict human separating direction when available, with primal residual retained. Optimality is not needed for the coefficient bound.
retention: All support states, finite fits, missing roots, numerical residuals and reference values retained. Paired contrasts use explicit common-fit denominators. No redraw after failure.
scope: Fully simulated model draws, not human respondents. This diagnostic does not establish new tuning, general dominance, or novelty of classical margin theory.
